_note: The READ of cell VERIFY-1, registered BEFORE contact. It is MODEL-FREE: exposure row SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-VERIFY-1-RECOVERY-READ-V1, zero model / tokenizer / encoder / scorer / server contacts. It RE-DERIVES NOTHING -- every comparator column is read from the sealed ROLL-1 per-sample official scores and from the offline aggregation read's committed report.

decision_rule.primary_read: All 625 rows: paired pooled official SLU-F1 of the chosen sealed sample versus mean-single. Report sample-0, medoid and explicitly metric-limited oracle references. Report 420 content-distinct, 414 all-parsed, 205 identical-answer controls and 225 row-F1-disagreeing strata separately beside the complete-roster result.
decision_rule.self_verification_works_if: The complete-roster paired CI95 lower bound for pooled SLU-F1 gain versus mean-single is positive and intent passes the preregistered operational non-inferiority guard from the R01C own-null. This opens a subsequent evidence-rich Reviewer design, not a system admission or test claim.
decision_rule.the_sampling_line_closes_if: No supported complete-roster selection benefit: stop this bounded selection route without claiming that larger sampling can never help. Position histograms diagnose presentation bias; similarity or non-significance of those histograms alone never proves absence of content information.
decision_rule.structural_acceptance: COMPLETED source and verifier manifests; exact 625 roster identities; every chosen position traceably resolves to the pinned source samples. Invalid choices use predeclared sealed source sample index 0 and remain in complete-roster estimates with separate failure/fallback counts. Selected malformed-source candidates are tagged, not dropped.
decision_rule.intervals: Paired utterance-cluster bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 20260915; official pooled counts and per-row F1 are separate estimands.
decision_rule.null_interpretation: VAR1 PLAN/PLANR intent margin is an operational guard only; its SLU half-width is not a universal threshold or an estimator of selector contrast variance.

inputs.sealed_rollout_scores: $SPEECHRL_DATA_DIR/analysis/SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-ROLLOUT-R01-SCORE-V1 -- the five per-sample official score files and per_row.json S3-3 sealed

context_only.note: CONTEXT ONLY, never a gate: cross-flight half-widths on other rosters at other n, plus the ROLL-AA within-flight floor at n = 200. This cell's comparison is BETWEEN-flight (its chosen-sample column against the sealed ROLL-1 sample columns), so the within-flight floor is not its margin either.

margins.primary_note: Seal the R01C own-null first. Its intent half-width is an operational NI guard; compute the selector contrast interval directly from its paired official counts.

prohibitions: Never re-score a sealed ROLL-1 sample and never run core.scoring_batch: this read invokes no scorer.
Never report a number from this cell as a test claim: R01C is a construction roster and its numbers are development numbers (owner decisions 28 and 86).
Never print or persist candidate text, utterance text, a transcript or gold.
Never hide malformed rows by reporting a favourable subset without the complete 625-row estimate.

steps.how: Parse all outputs with the registered parser and max_reason_chars=160. Count failures, apply sealed-source-index-0 fallback and retain every row.
Report all-roster and separate informative/control choice-position histograms. Chi-square is descriptive; its significance alone is not a content-selection test.
Resolve displayed positions with the sealed balanced-block-v1 permutation. Report source-index histograms without treating a particular histogram shape as proof of incorrect mapping.

For each informative row, the ORACLE best-of-5 sample index is the one with the highest sealed per-row official SLU-F1 (ties: the full tie set). Report the share of rows whose chosen sample is IN the oracle tie set, and the same share for a random choice (1/5 adjusted for tie-set size) as the null. This is a metric-limited diagnostic; complete-roster pooled quality is primary.
steps.what: ORACLE AGREEMENT ON THE INFORMATIVE POPULATION

steps.how: Build the chosen-sample column by taking each row's chosen sample's SEALED per-row official counts and pooling them exactly as the offline read proved the reconstruction identity (R1 reconstructed 57.90644985971403 vs R1 scored as a copy 57.90644985971403, absolute difference 0.0). Report it against R0-mean-single, R1-medoid and ORACLE, with the paired row bootstrap (10,000 draws, seed 20260915), on all 625 rows, on the informative 420 / 414, on the control 205, and on the 225 score-disagreeing subset. NO new scoring job is run and no scorer is invoked: every comparator column is already committed.
steps.what: POOLED SLU-F1 AND INTENT OF 'DELIVER THE CHOSEN SAMPLE'

steps.how: The two partitions are DIFFERENT and both are reported. 'Content distinct' (420) means the five rendered candidates are not all the same text; 'score disagreeing' (225) means the five sealed per-row SLU-F1 values are not all equal. Every score-disagreeing row is content distinct; the 195 content-distinct-but-score-agreeing rows are where a choice changes the delivered text without changing the per-row score, and they expose the limitations of row-F1 as a feedback signal, including empty-entity false positives and intent ties.
steps.what: THE 225 SCORE-DISAGREEING SUBSET BESIDE THE 420 CONTENT-DISTINCT

steps.how: Oracle agreement and chosen-sample SLU-F1 per SLURP scenario, from the R01C roster receipt's own per-item stratum. Diagnostics with no CI, never gates: the strata are 26-42 rows.
Realised contacts per row (expected 1.0), realised GPU hours, the distribution of reason lengths, and the realised contact count against the registered ceiling.
